I will do this plot the way I know and the way other women around me do when money is tight. This plot is small, and I own it, so I will put manure if I can get enough from home, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer because one bag costs too much for me. I will keep my local seed, I will not irrigate, and I will use family work little by little for planting, weeding, and harvesting.
